facts.text: Parking is inside the park only: there is none outside it. Postcode GL7 6DF.
The beach shelves very gently, and the water is at most about 1.5 metres deep in the bathing season.
Two toilet blocks, one at each end of the park, and a disabled toilet at the main entrance. Open during business hours.
Basic changing rooms, male and female, at AquaVenture, with small keyed lockers for keys, wallets and phones held by the lifeguards. No toilets at AquaVenture, and no showers anywhere on site.
Entry needs an admission ticket, best booked online. Once the park is full there is no entry on the gate.
An admission season pass costs £120 and lasts a year from purchase; the park is closed in winter.
Closed for winter: the last day of the 2026 season was Sunday 27 September.
Swim only from the beach out to the buoy line, where the lifeguards watch. Do not swim from any other point around South or North Lake.
